grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Study Goals and Habits: A Conversation Between Friends
instructions: 听录音，完成10个问题。录音播放两遍。答案必须来自录音内容。
transcript:
Mia: Hi Leo! What are you doing? 
Leo: I'm making a study plan. I have a big English test next month. 
Mia: That's great. Do you study every day? 
Leo: No, I don't. I study on weekdays, but not on weekends. 
Mia: How often do you study English? 
Leo: I usually study English three times a week. Sometimes I study with my friend Anna. 
Mia: Does Anna study with you every Friday? 
Leo: No, she doesn't. We study together sometimes, but not every Friday. 
Mia: What about your other subjects? 
Leo: I always do my math homework after dinner. I sometimes review science notes in the morning. 
Mia: Do you have a favorite study habit? 
Leo: Yes, I do. I make flashcards for new words. I review them on the bus. 
Mia: That's a good idea. Do you listen to music when you study? 
Leo: No, I don't. I need quiet. But my sister listens to music. 
Mia: Does your sister study with you? 
Leo: No, she doesn't. She studies in her room. 
Mia: What are you doing now? 
Leo: I'm writing my study plan. I'm also drinking tea. 
Mia: Good luck with your test! 
Leo: Thanks!

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, sometimes, never）连用。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是 be (am/is/are) + 动词-ing。do/does 用于一般现在时的疑问句和否定句。
grammar.example: I usually study English three times a week. (一般现在时) / I'm making a study plan. (现在进行时) / Do you study every day? (do 问句) / Does Anna study with you? (does 问句)

questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。所以 'She always studies English.' 正确。
一般现在时的疑问句用助动词 do/does，主语是第三人称单数用 does，动词用原形。所以 'Does he study every day?' 正确。
现在进行时的结构是 be + 动词-ing。主语 they 用 are，所以 'They are playing football now.' 正确。

options: I don't usually watch TV in the morning.

answers: I don't usually watch TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时的否定句用 don't/doesn't。主语 I 用 don't，所以 'I don't usually watch TV in the morning.' 正确。
